whitePrevisLeadInInstruction: PRE-ROLL 0:00-{start}: hold the opening pose and prop state; no story action yet. Complete photographic Look Sheet faces from frame 0, never white faces or guide lines. The full usable action lasts {duration}s starting at {start}; hold after it until the source clip ends.

compositionReferenceMode.promptPrefix: Create one fully photorealistic live-action take from frame one, with real actors on a physical set in natural color.
compositionReferenceMode.startAuthority: Image 1 supplies opening camera, blocking, geometry and light placement, NOT facial identity. Blank faces and faint guide lines indicate head angle only. Authored starting hand/prop contact, time, weather and performance override incidental reference content.
compositionReferenceMode.characterMapping: Image {imageNumber}: PRIMARY face and Look Sheet for {roleName}, Look {lookName}; this person only.
compositionReferenceMode.prohibitions: No blank faces, guide lines, drawn texture, animation, CGI humans, copied sheet panels, swapped identities or unrequested text.
compositionReferenceMode.sectionLabel: SCENE COMPOSITION AND LOOK SHEET REFERENCES

lookFacialIdentityInstruction: BEFORE output time 0:00 (frame 0), reconstruct every visible face as an anatomically complete photographic face from that person's OWN Look Sheet. Looks OVERRIDE scene facial appearance: match face shape, age, eyes, nose, mouth, skin and hair. Preserve head pose and occlusion; no forced frontal faces or features on back-facing/hidden heads. Keep identity through motion, turns and reappearance. No blank initial faces, guide lines, delayed face reveal, morph or fade-in. Keep wardrobe and authored expression/gaze. Continuous real video throughout.

sketchReferenceMode.promptPrefix: Shoot one fully photorealistic live-action take from frame one: real actors on a physical set, not an animated or colorized drawing. Image 1 provides staging only; rebuild every surface photographically.
sketchReferenceMode.startAuthority: Match image 1's composition, blocking, gaze and prop positions, not its marks or shading. Render real skin pores, individual hair, woven fabric, solid props and optical depth with physical shadows/reflections. Authored time/weather/light override sketch tone. Look Sheets govern identity, age and wardrobe.
sketchReferenceMode.characterMapping: Image {imageNumber}: Look Sheet for {roleName}, Look {lookName}; identity and wardrobe only.
sketchReferenceMode.prohibitions: No pencil texture, painted faces/backgrounds, cartoon, CGI look, flat cutouts, 2.5D parallax, sketch-to-real transition or text. No copied sheet poses, duplicate/swapped characters or future prop events. The entire frame must look filmed.

textOnlyMode.promptPrefix: Create one continuous cinematic live-action shot from the authored scene. No reference image or visible character is supplied.
textOnlyMode.startAuthority: Compose the opening from the authored location, visual moment, camera, art direction and motivated lighting.
textOnlyMode.prohibitions: Do not introduce people or reference-sheet layouts. Preserve the authored environment, props and continuity.

textOnlyMode.promptPrefix: Create one continuous cinematic live-action shot from the authored scene. No reference image or visible character is supplied.
textOnlyMode.startAuthority: Compose the opening from the authored location, visual moment, camera, art direction and motivated lighting.
textOnlyMode.prohibitions: Do not introduce people or reference-sheet layouts. Preserve the authored environment, props and continuity.

looksOnlyMode.promptPrefix: Use character look sheet references to preserve each named character's identity and wardrobe. Create one continuous photorealistic live-action shot from the authored scene and action below.
looksOnlyMode.startAuthority: No First Frame is supplied. Compose the opening from the authored visible moment, blocking, camera, location and lighting below.
looksOnlyMode.characterMapping: Image {imageNumber} is the Look Sheet for {roleName}, Look {lookName}. Preserve this character's identity and wardrobe only.
looksOnlyMode.prohibitions: Never reproduce sheet panels, labels, multiple views, neutral poses or sheet backgrounds. Do not duplicate or swap characters. Use the authored scene and performance, not the sheet composition.

compactCompositionEnvironment: Use the approved composition image for set geometry, palette and physical materials. Preserve the authored time, light and state below.

phrasing.startFrame: Begin from the approved Storyboard image as the immutable first frame.
phrasing.preserveStartFrame: Preserve every visible identity, garment, prop, spatial relation and motivated light source from that frame.
phrasing.primaryAction: One primary action: {value}. Keep authored cause/action/reaction order and prop contact until release; invent no support or cause. React to visible events, not text or exact words. Respect weight/gravity; no hovering, teleporting or repeated falls.
phrasing.manualTimeline: Manual timeline, local to this clip starting at 0:00: perform ONLY these events in this order at the exact intervals. Do not merge, reorder, retime or add events; preserve state in gaps.
phrasing.manualTakeWindow: Authored timeline below is unchanged. This Take stops at {seconds}s of action time. Execute only the portion within that window; later events are continuity notes, not actions for this Take. Do not accelerate, compress, or move later events earlier.
phrasing.manualDuration: Clip duration: {seconds}s. The timeline alone controls action, camera moves, performance changes and end state; no automatic extra events.
phrasing.manualCamera: Preserve opening framing unless the timeline directs a camera move.
phrasing.manualPromptSuffix: Continuous real video throughout, with natural physical motion and photographic surfaces; never a still or slideshow.
phrasing.duration: Duration: {seconds}s. Honor authored timing; otherwise real time with readable start/reaction. Falling objects accelerate. Slow motion/speed ramps only if directed; no filler events.
phrasing.stableCamera: Keep the camera restrained and stable.
phrasing.cameraImperfection: Keep optical and handheld imperfections subtle and compatible with the authored camera direction.

globalProhibitions: Do not render readable text in any language: no titles, subtitles, captions, dialogue lettering, logos or readable signs/screens. Keep dialogue audio-only; communicate story through visible action and reaction.
Do not change character identity, apparent age, body proportions, hairstyle or approved wardrobe.
Do not invent {actionScope}, a new scene, a new Character, dialogue, prop or camera move.
Avoid synthetic CGI surfaces, plastic skin, beauty filtering and mechanically perfect motion.
